title: Runtime capabilities
summary: Capability declarations mirrored for compatible runtime clients.
purpose: Lets callers gate optional operations without inferring runtime support from type presence.
lifecycle: Fetched from a runtime client and evaluated before each optional operation.

fieldConstraints.constraint: Documentation support states are supported, unsupported, conditional, or unknown.

behavior.errors: Capability discovery failures leave support unknown.
behavior.retry: Discovery may be retried under the provider transport policy.
behavior.cancellation: A cancellation capability does not guarantee a particular upstream termination latency.
behavior.streaming: Stream must be reported and implemented before use.

valid.expected: The caller also checks streamRun before streaming.

invalid.expectedFailure: The value does not match the packed capability field type.

compatibilityNotes: Capabilities are observations of an upstream implementation, not protocol ownership claims.
